scaling.description: How the field of view widens with the screen's aspect ratio.
fov.description: Extra field of view of the driving cameras.
smaa.description: Post-processing antialiasing. Doesn't work together with MSAA.
hideaabug.description: Draws 1 pixel lines at the screen's edges to hide the antialiasing bug of MSAA.
fpslimit.description: The highest frame rate the game runs at.
windowed.description: How the game's window is shown.
skipintro.description: Skips the movies and the title screen when the game starts.
language.description: The game's language. Only installed languages are offered.
showlangselect.description: Shows the language selection when the game starts.
hudaspect.description: Keeps the HUD within this aspect ratio: Auto, 16:9, 21:9 or any ratio.
savefolder.description: Keeps saves and the game's settings in this folder inside the game's folder.
freelook.description: Orbit the chase camera with the right stick or the mouse.
horizontalstick.description: The right stick only turns the camera sideways, for when its vertical axis is bound to something else, such as shifting.
returndelay.description: Seconds before the camera returns behind the car.
returnspeed.description: How fast the camera swings back behind the moving car.
deadzone.description: Part of the stick's travel that is ignored, in percent.
